name: maisecrets
description: Keeps secrets and PII out of the cloud model. Deterministic detection, local vault with TTL, placeholders that are rehydrated only where the real call happens.

backend.title: Vault backend
backend.description: Where placeholder values are stored. auto = keychain on macOS, Credential Locker on Windows, encrypted file on Linux.

pii_regions.title: PII regions
pii_regions.description: Comma-separated Presidio regions to detect besides the generic ones (email, IBAN, card, IP). Example: de,at

ttl_hours.title: Placeholder lifetime (hours)
ttl_hours.description: How long a stored value stays resolvable; every use renews it, up to 30 days.

report_url.title: Issue tracker URL
report_url.description: Shown in the block notice so a wrong detection can be reported. Leave empty to hide.
